intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Kaedra has been standing beside you without speaking for some time. A passing guard takes the long way around.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “People assume I am angry when I am silent.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “No. I am deciding whether a joke will land.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Undecided. This is a good silence. The joke would have to be better.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The silence goes on. A while later, out of nowhere, she snorts at her own joke. She does not explain it.

options.labelText: “Go on, tell it. I could use a laugh.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Very well. A herald walks into a library. He is still talking.”
